messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing hero + CTA split for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before go-live next Wed. Need final copy, CTA routing, and webinar tie-in. Who can take which piece?
Sam: I can own CTA routing + analytics tags. putting together a simple mapping.
Lucas: I’ll do hero visuals once copy is locked. need word counts for each variant.
Tara: Drafted 3 short hero options per mode. Posting them here for quick pick.
Tara: Hosted — option A: "Fastest path to production LLMs — Hosted API with predictable pricing and streaming responses."
Tara: Hosted — CTA ideas: [Start free], [View benchmarks], [Join webinar]
Tara: Dedicated — option A: "Reserved GPU capacity. Enterprise SLAs, isolated data. For predictable throughput."
Tara: Dedicated — CTA ideas: [Request demo], [Dedicated benchmarks], [Talk to sales]
Tara: Private — option A: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem. Full control, audited access, KMS/HSM support."
Tara: Private — CTA ideas: [Schedule consult], [Compliance brief], [Private onboarding]
Priya: Love the direction. small ask: make Hosted hero more outcome-led — "ship features faster" language.
Sam: Routing plan (first pass): map CTAs to lead funnels + event names for tracking.
Sam: ```
/cta -> hosted_trial_form (utm=cta_hosted)
/request-demo -> demo_queue (utm=cta_dedicated)
/schedule-consult -> sales_inbound (utm=cta_private)
/register-webinar -> webinar_list (utm=cta_webinar)
```
Sam: Will add GTM events and HubSpot field mapping after we decide exact CTA slugs.
Jamie: Webinar tie: propose a panel on "Reducing inference cost by 3x" showing Hosted benchmarks + Dedicated sizing patterns. Use benchmark snippets on page as social proof.
Maya: Good. Tara — can you write the short benchmark blurbs (1-2 lines) that we can drop under hero for Hosted and Dedicated? Example: "Hosted: 2–4x faster than baseline on 8k seq (median latency)."
Tara: Yup. Drafts: Hosted: "Median token latency 30–50ms on common prompts; optimized batching lowers per-token cost by 40%." Dedicated: "Sustained throughput for 1000s of RPS with 99.95% availability — predictable unit economics."
Lucas: For design: do we want the benchmark line under hero or as a small badge strip? prefer badge strip with micro-CTAs.
Priya: Badge strip + link to full benchmark page. want short social copy too for launch post.
Tara: Launch post (short): "Announcing Redwood Inference: predictable, production-grade LLM serving across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Join our webinar 4/12 to see benchmarks & migration tips."
Sam: Social CTA -> webinar for mid-market, trial for PLG, demo for enterprise. I'll wire that to our paid channels.
Maya: Inbound lead routing — prioritization: demo leads (Dedicated/Private) flagged as P1; hosted-trial signups auto-nurture P2; webinar registrants tagged P3 but moved to nurture flow.
Sam: Noted. will add workflow: P1 -> AE alert + 2 business hour SLA; P2 -> trial onboarding drip; P3 -> webinar follow-up + benchmark e-mail.
Jamie: Also want an experiment: swap Hosted hero CTA between [Start free] and [View benchmarks] on 50/50 and measure downstream activation in 7 days.
Maya: Love it. Tara, please prepare final microcopy for all CTAs by EOD tomorrow. Lucas, lock font sizes and hero layout by EOD so we can do dev handoff Thu.
Lucas: On it. will post Figma link when ready.
Tara: Will do. post final copy here when done.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging page build scheduled for 1719616000. Automated smoke tests will run after deploy. :robot_face:
Maya: Great — thanks everyone. if no blockers we’ll ship the hero + CTAs to staging Friday, public Monday.
Priya: One last note — include a small line about data handling on forms for Private leads (auditable + KMS) to reduce compliance friction.
Tara: Added to Private microcopy: "Includes audit logging, KMS integration, and SOC-ready controls."
Maya: Perfect. closing thread — follow ups in #product-ops if implementation questions.
